使用范围\r\nWindows x64 / Steam 普通单人模式。配套插件随:
Supported use
Windows x64 / Steam, standard single-player mode. The game plugin is included. Self-contained packages need no separate .NET, CE, or Docker installation. The first launch may generate game interfaces or obtain files required by the loader.
本机会发生什么\r\n准备流程先核对游戏版本，再备份当前存档。安装会写入游戏目录:
Changes on this computer
Preparation checks the game version, then backs up the current saves. Installation adds loader files, such as winhttp.dll and doorstop_config.ini, and the BepInEx folder to the game directory, and saves an installation manifest. Uninstalling follows that manifest and preserves files changed by other tools.
数据与控制\r\n修改器窗口通过当前用户的本机命名管道连接游戏，不上传游戏或存档:
Data and control
The trainer connects to the game through a local named pipe restricted to the current user. It uploads no game or save data and collects no usage telemetry.
